answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked work history, split across independent auditors, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The signal is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the quill. By the wander of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
